title: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero

entities.name: Reen
entities.description: A Monoist gravkill paladin and squad captain from Susur Secundi on a pilgrimage to Point Prime, haunted by her part in the slaughter at Joska and tattooing a ledger of her kills.

entities.name: Too Much Happiness
entities.description: An android mechan captain and body-ship who carries Reen to Point Prime, affected by glitches and a strange presence met in the Wurmwall.

entities.name: Infinite Guideline
entities.description: A neutral Pinnacle station and last stop before leaving the Sothera system.

entities.name: Point Prime
entities.description: The Monoist holy destination, a lightless supervoid-like place that Reen is making her pilgrimage toward.

entities.name: Susur Secundi
entities.description: The Monoist home of subterranean warrens orbiting a collapsing star and a nascent supervoid.

entities.name: Joska
entities.description: A moon with violet seas where Reen's squad destroyed a Palatinate lander of three hundred colonists, the atrocity that ended the negotiated peace.

entities.name: Wurmwall
entities.description: A cloud of debris around Sothera inhabited by greatwurms, where Too Much Happiness met a stranger.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: The star system containing Susur Secundi and Infinite Guideline.

entities.name: Monasteriat
entities.description: The governing body of the Monoist faith, sending Reen on pilgrimage and welcoming displaced persons to Susur Secundi.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: The pride and blade of the Celestial Palatinate, whose golden-caped soldiers share Reen's ship and are killed by her.

entities.name: Celestial Palatinate
entities.description: The empire that seeks to resurrect Sothera's collapsed star and other supervoids, in fragile peace with the Monoists until the Joska atrocity.

entities.name: The Faller
entities.description: The Monoist figure who tumbled past an event horizon into a supervoid and found peace.

entities.name: Greatwurms
entities.description: Enormous lamprey-mouthed creatures of the Wurmwall that scarred Too Much Happiness's engine pod.

entities.name: Horizon javelin
entities.description: The Palatinate's supervoid-reigniting weapon, which Reen thinks might be trivial compared to whatever she sensed in the ship's core.

events.summary: Reen arrives at Infinite Guideline seeking a ship with a drive and a codebook for her pilgrimage.
events.quote: And her obligate pilgrimage will take her even farther—that is, if she ever finds a half-decent ship with a drive and a codebook.

events.summary: A malfunctioning scavenger mechan tries to eat Reen's oversized suitcase and she throws it aside.
events.quote: a malfunctioning scavenger mechan trying to eat her oversized suitcase, drawn to its metal-rich contents.

events.summary: A Kav captain refuses to take Reen to Point Prime directly.
events.quote: "Point Prime from here?" he demands.

events.summary: Reen finds that captains fear the route to Point Prime and begins to doubt her pilgrimage.
events.quote: Point Prime is far, yes. But distance is the least of the captains' concerns.

events.summary: The mechan captain Too Much Happiness reveals it is also going to Point Prime.
events.quote: "What serendipity," it says.

events.summary: Reen books passage with Too Much Happiness.
events.quote: She puts in her offer. The transfer and contract blink through.

events.summary: Reen sees that her fellow passengers are three Sunstar Free Company men-at-arms.
events.quote: There are three of them: three men-at-arms belonging to the Sunstar Free Company, pride and blade of the Celestial Palatinate.

events.summary: The soldiers fail to recognize Reen and walk past.
events.quote: She reminds the men-at-arms of nothing, and they stride past her without stopping.

events.summary: Reen recites a Monoist chant in her cabin and is startled when Too Much Happiness speaks through her mirror.
events.quote: compact me to zero and let me be still.

events.summary: The ship enters the eternity column and travels through unreality.
events.quote: Then the eternity column activates, flinging them through unreality

events.summary: In memory, Reen recalls Joska and the Palatinate lander that her squad targeted.
events.quote: If she keeps her eyes shut, she sees, inevitably, the target: a Palatinate lander bobbing just offshore.

events.summary: Reen tattoos a supervoid mark on her arm as a ledger of her kills.
events.quote: The tiny black tattoo, a stylized and simplified supervoid, is nearly finished.

events.summary: Reen sees the striations on the engine pod are from a greatwurm attack in the Wurmwall.
events.quote: The striations make a new and terrifying sense

events.summary: Too Much Happiness says it was compelled into the Wurmwall and met a stranger there.
events.quote: I think I met a stranger there, and things have been far stranger since.

events.summary: Reen suspects a Palatinate hack and agrees to inspect the memory cores.
events.quote: If the Palatinate really is using the Wurmwall as a staging ground and seeks to conceal its activities …

events.summary: Reen finds an alien fractal shadow growing inside the ship's core code.
events.quote: A fractal shadow of Too Much Happiness's core systems that seems to wink out of existence each time she peers too closely at it.

events.summary: Reen realizes the ancient alien presence might make the Palatinate's horizon javelin look trivial.
events.quote: She realizes she's stumbled onto something that, if weaponized, might make the Palatinate's horizon javelin look trivial by comparison.

events.summary: A Sunstar soldier catches Reen at the memory cores with a bladiator at her neck.
events.quote: The others didn't believe me. But I can always sniff out your kind.

events.summary: Too Much Happiness warns that the peace is ending and cuts the lights.
events.quote: I have received word that the negotiated peace is ending. A great atrocity was uncovered.

events.summary: Reen stabs the soldier in the eye with a pneumatic needle in the dark and flees.
events.quote: drives her pneumatic needle into something yielding and aqueous.

events.summary: Reen sprints through the dark to the cargo hold with three soldiers in pursuit.
events.quote: Monoists revere the dark; Reen has spent half her life in lightless tunnels

events.summary: Reen locks herself in her suitcase while her armor assembles and the soldiers cut through the door.
events.quote: It splits open at the same time the cargo door hisses shut.

events.summary: The soldiers breach the cargo hold.
events.quote: The sheared metal of the door topples forward, discharging another shower of sparks. The men-at-arms step through.

events.summary: Reen surrenders to rage, activates her gravity gauntlets and emerges from the suitcase to fight.
events.quote: Reen activates her gravity gauntlets and emerges.

events.summary: After the fight, the maintenance mechans and Reen send the dead soldiers out an airlock.
events.quote: A moving wave of maintenance mechans conducted the soldiers to the airlock; Reen helped push their shattered corpses through.

events.summary: Too Much Happiness connects Reen's tattoos to the Joska atrocity that ended the peace.
events.quote: The atrocity that ended the negotiated peace occurred on the moon called Joska.

events.summary: Reen says she will condense and be still as they approach Point Prime.
events.quote: "I'll condense," she says.

relations.note: The Monasteriat sends Reen back to war.
relations.quote: it won't be long before the Monasteriat sends her back to war.

relations.note: Their peace is fragile and ends after the Joska atrocity.
relations.quote: the peace between the Monoists and the Palatinate is a fragile one.

relations.note: The Free Company is the pride and blade of the Palatinate.
relations.quote: three men-at-arms belonging to the Sunstar Free Company, pride and blade of the Celestial Palatinate.

relations.note: The mechan captain helps Reen by cutting the lights and the cargo door.
relations.quote: I am about to experience a lighting malfunction, Passenger Reen

relations.note: Reen hates the Sunstar soldiers and kills the three aboard.
